text:
tara: Heads up 7: support flagged a KB article with an embedded diagram that 403s. The page is /docs/architecture/serving-cache and the image src points to the old CDN path.

jon: Which image? I can try the link.

tara: It's the "serving-caching-arch.png" in the diagrams folder. Staging shows 200 but prod 403. Likely an ACL on the CDN object after migration.

jon: I'll claim this. Short plan: (1) rehost image in docs static assets bucket, (2) update the markdown image path to /assets/diagrams/serving-caching-arch.png, (3) add `alt` text and an attribution line in the caption.

liam: Also add a tiny frontmatter `assets:` block or `images:` field so the asset rehosting is obvious to future editors. We've had recurring 403s when people link to raw S3 paths.

jon: Good call. Keeping the PR tiny. I'll also add a one-line CI smoke check to ensure images under /docs/architecture/* resolve (follow-up issue).

docs-bot: Opened issue #4991: "KB: serving-cache diagram 403 in prod - rehost + update path" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4991 :white_check_mark:

tara: Thanks jon. Can you @me on the PR so I can validate with support repro?

jon: Will do, opening PR now.

liam: For the follow-up, I can sketch a small `linkinator` job that only checks image URLs under /assets/ to avoid noise. Let's make that a separate ticket.

jon: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3301 - small image move + md update. Landing after quick review.

tara: Verified post-merge that the diagram loads in prod. Closing loop.
